# Exact build backend for the release workflow, with hashes, so a new or compromised release of the
# backend or its dependencies cannot change what gets published. After changing the backend, regenerate
# it (the command replaces the file, so copy this header back):
#   echo '<backend>==<version>' | uv pip compile - --generate-hashes --python-version 3.12 --no-header -o .github/build-constraints.txt
